subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrowed policy that makes Google/Gemini auth-profile env refs file-backed in generated service environments while leaving other auth-profile env refs unchanged?
rationale: The code path is small and source-backed, but it changes where provider credentials are delivered for installed services; CI can prove mechanics, not the intended security and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
options.body: Merge this PR after green gates if maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

options.title: Request Generic Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revision that routes safe auth-profile env refs through a common policy instead of a Google/Gemini allowlist.

options.title: Keep Auth-Profile Scope Separate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the linked security issue limited to config SecretRefs and separate auth-profile work later.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after green gates if maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current-main config SecretRef repair for the same security issue and authored adjacent render-policy follow-up commits.
